description: Convert a mail BODY STRING between markdown and HTML. SYNCHRONOUS: the converted body comes back in this call — there is no job_id and nothing to poll. This is NOT convert_document. convert_document takes a FILE (PDF/DOCX/…), runs on a worker, and returns a job_id you must poll; this takes a string and answers immediately. Picking the wrong one fails silently — you read undefined where you expected a body. State `from` and `to` explicitly; nothing is ever sniffed, and they MUST differ. Returns { content, from, to, mode, size_original, size_converted }. The `content` input is capped at 65,536 UTF-8 BYTES, not characters — a body of accented or CJK text reaches the cap at as few as ~16,000 characters, and over-limit input is rejected rather than truncated.

content.description: The body to convert. Max 65,536 UTF-8 BYTES — count bytes, not characters, for any non-ASCII body.

from.description: Format of `content`. Declared, never detected. Must differ from `to`.

mode.description: raw = converter output unmodified, matching what the send/read paths produce today; fit = default, adapted for the destination and round-trip stable (markdown→html→markdown returns the original); minimal = smallest faithful output.

to.description: Format to convert into. Must differ from `from`.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: convert_mail_body
